code.pseudocode: A and B have the same mean.
Compare how far apart each distribution's values are.
Measure spread relative to the mean of A.
deviation = value - mean. Their weighted average is always 0.
Squaring removes the signs and punishes large deviations more.
Do the same for B and compare the two variances.
Standard deviation = square root of variance, in the original units.
